Cardinals vs Seahawks Betting History

The Arizona Cardinals and Seattle Seahawks have met 55 times since the 1976 season. The Seahawks lead the series 32-22-1. Against the closing spread the Cardinals are 25-28-1 (Seahawks 28-25-1), and the over is 27-26 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Sep 20, 2026, Seahawks 31-7.
